Conservation of momentum applies best when external forces dominate the system.

questions.question: In an isolated system, total momentum before equals total momentum ________.
What happens to momentum when a moving ball hits a still ball and stops?
questions.correctAnswer: A good answer says momentum transfers to the second ball and total remains conserved.
questions.explanation: The first ball transfers momentum to the second ball, so the total system momentum remains the same.
